name: Phoenix
source:
The stoic co-worker with a professional facade that can be hard to read.

They're ambitious and focused, although they can be socially aloof sometimes...

[From [url=http://boyslaughplus.moe/todo-today]official website[/url]]

Phoenix's gender (male, female, or non-binary) depends on the answers the player gives during the Bell Tech survey.
